idea-plugin.name: JarLibsConsolidator
idea-plugin.description:
A one-click tool plugin for collecting JAR dependencies and loose .class files in your project. It copies JARs to an "all-in-one" folder, restores class package paths from bytecode, and adds the JAR and class roots as a project library attached to all modules.

Features:
• One-click operation: Right-click project → Select "Add Dependencies"
• Smart scanning: Recursively scans .jar files, skipping common directories (node_modules, target, build, .gradle, .mvn, etc.)
• Duplicate handling: Automatically renames duplicate JARs with suffixes (x.jar → x_2.jar)
• Unified management: Copies to all-in-one/ directory and creates project-level library
• Loose class files: Includes build outputs, restores package paths, and supports projects without JARs
• Directory or ZIP export: Exports CLASS or JAVA sources from registered dependency libraries with allow/deny filters; JAVA uses IDEA's bundled decompiler
• Declared IDE compatibility: IntelliJ IDEA builds 223–262.* (including IU-262.10315.125)

中文说明：
一键收集项目中的 JAR 和独立 class 文件。按字节码包名整理 class 目录，复制到 all-in-one 文件夹，自动加入项目库并关联所有模块，让 IDEA 能识别这些类。

Project URL: https://github.com/Le1a/JarLibsConsolidator
